name: machete
description: Translucent overlay that sees your screen, listens to the conversation and answers with your ChatGPT plan.

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Machete transcribes your microphone so it can answer with conversation context.
extendInfo.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Machete transcribes audio on-device to build a live transcript.
extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: Machete reads your screen and system audio to answer questions about what you are looking at.
